summary: A warm, near-monochrome reading room: Manila-paper ground, one deep verdigris accent used as rarely as a librarian's stamp, hairline borders carrying all structure, and a deliberately static interface that earns its calm from typography and whitespace rather than from effects.
antiReferences: dashboard / tech-feel: no telemetry aesthetic, no dense metric panels, no sci-fi blue gradients, no chrome implying a running machine
SaaS landing page: no gradient hero, no glassmorphism, no oversized decorative display type, no conversion-shaped CTA blocks
magazine cover: no decorative serif headlines, no emotion-led typographic spectacle, no ornamental layout tricks

namedRules.name: The One Accent Rule
namedRules.rationale: Verdigris is the only colour on the site not derived from paper or ink, so its scarcity is what makes a hovered link mean 'this is live'. Used once per viewport it reads as signal; used twice it reads as decoration and stops carrying information.

namedRules.name: The Flat-By-Hairline Rule
namedRules.rationale: Depth here is panel-versus-paper plus a 1px border. A hover changes the border colour and nothing else, because a card that lifts imports a physical metaphor this archive does not have. A new component that seems to need depth needs a border first.

namedRules.name: The CJK Floor Rule
namedRules.rationale: Chinese glyphs occupy the full em box, so a 15px CJK line falls below the comfortable reading floor — especially in mixed Latin/numeric articles, which this corpus is full of. 16px is therefore a hard floor, not a preference.

primary.role: The single accent. Appears on hovered links, the active nav item, the ranking numeral, primary buttons and every focus edge.
primary.doNotUseAs: A section background, a gradient stop, a decorative fill, or a resting surface of any size.

accessibility.notes: Both themes pass AA for normal text. Dark-mode verdigris also inverts its contrast colour to #000; do not carry the light theme's #fff onto it.

typography.primaryFamily: Inter, PingFang SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, Hiragino Sans GB, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif
typography.monoFamily: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, Noto Sans Mono CJK SC, monospace

roles.purpose: Board and section headings — clamp(30px, 6vw, 48px), weight 400, 1.08 leading.
roles.why:
The site's signature inversion: the board's

is a 13px/700 eyebrow and this display size sits beneath it in a

. The small loud label above the large quiet title is the move, so the h1 must stay small.
Weight 700 is required at this size over warm paper; 600 disappears into the ground once CJK strokes thin out.

roles.purpose: Card titles — 18px, weight 600, 1.3 leading, single line with ellipsis.
roles.why: Fixed at one line so a row of cards shares a baseline. Letting a title wrap is what breaks the grid's rhythm.

roles.purpose: Site body 16px/1.75; article prose 17.5px/1.75 capped at 72ch.
roles.why: 1.75 leading is the CJK-comfortable value — Latin-only sites default to 1.5–1.6 and Chinese glyphs close up badly there. The 72ch measure is what keeps 17.5px prose readable at that leading.

roles.purpose: The 11–13px band carrying all metadata: captions, chips, pagers, bylines, stats. Weight varies 600–700 for eyebrows and badges; size band does not.
roles.why: Metadata is a class, not a set of one-offs. Holding the band means a new caption inherits the right tier instead of inventing 12.5px.

spacing.note: Derived from measured usage, not declared as a scale in code. 6px is the control padding/gap floor, 16px the grid gap, 24px the container inset. Gaps of 18px (header) and 7px/8px (icon-adjacent) sit between them and are fine.

borders.color: hairline (#dfe4e1) / hairline-soft (#e9ede9) in light; rgba(255,255,255,0.15) / rgba(255,255,255,0.09) in dark
borders.rules: No doubled borders, no inset shadows, no clipped or angled corners, no decorative geometry. Dark-theme borders are alpha-white, never solid grey.

shadows.rules: Exactly one shadow, reserved for genuinely floating layers (theme and language menus). Nothing in document flow may cast one.

layout.grid: Single centred column, max-width 1180px, 24px side padding.
layout.cardGrid: auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr), 16px gap — yields 3–4 columns at container width. Cards equal-height, cover cropped to fill, metadata pinned bottom.
layout.header: Sticky, 58px tall, translucent veil with 12px backdrop blur, 18px inner gap. Nav, category filter and search share one row and the column cannot widen to give them room.
layout.pagination: 12 per page; page number at the left edge, both controls at the right.

breakpoints: 700px (header loses single-row arrangement — the decisive one)

focusRing.style: 2px solid accent, drawn inset at outline-offset: -1px, on :focus-visible
focusRing.whyInset: `.card-article` is overflow:hidden because that is what clips its cover to the radius, so an outset ring around the card's title link would be cut off on both sides. Inset is never clipped by an ancestor.
focusRing.secondaryCue: Inputs and selects also darken their border to accent-dim. Supplementary, never a substitute.
focusRing.exception: The theme and language switches redirect the ring from their visually-hidden radio onto the visible option; the offset still matches.

components.pattern: 8px radius, 8px 16px padding, 14px label. Secondary = panel-sunk fill + hairline border (the default and majority case); primary = verdigris fill + white 600 label, used sparingly for admin actions only.
components.do: Change the secondary's border and text to verdigris on hover; brighten the primary 8% without changing hue.
components.dont: Don't add a resting shadow, a gradient, or a transform on hover.

components.pattern: 10px surface radius, overflow hidden, panel fill, 1px hairline. Cover cropped to fill in a fixed 150px-height box — pinned height, not an aspect ratio, so the same card is the same height in every grid — flush to the top and side borders. Single-line ellipsised 18px/600 title, 13.5px excerpt clamped to two lines at 1.55, 12px metadata pinned bottom.
components.do: Let the hairline and the panel-versus-paper step do all the structural work.
components.dont: Don't lift, scale, shadow, or transform on hover — border colour only, 0.15s.

components.pattern: 999px radius, 4px 11px padding, 13px label, transparent fill, 1px hairline border.
components.do: On hover step text up to ink and the border to the faint tier — the cards' two-step lift at smaller amplitude.
components.dont: Don't fill a chip or give it an accent background; taxonomy classifies, it does not act.

components.pattern: 7px radius, 6px 11px padding, panel fill, 1px hairline border.
components.do: Keep native appearance suppressed and any icon hand-authored.
components.dont: Don't restore native appearance or introduce an icon font.

components.pattern: Same geometry as the input — 7px radius, panel fill, 108px fixed — so it reads as one unit with the search box beside it. The caret is a masked sibling, not a background image, so it takes its colour from currentColor and follows both theme and state.
components.do: Give the selected state the nav's own accent fill, token for token, and invert the caret with it.
components.dont: Don't hardcode a colour into the caret's mask, and don't let the selected control look identical to its idle state — it is the only place the header names the current category.

components.pattern: 7px radius, 6px 9px padding, 14px label, 6px icon gap. Resting ink-muted on transparent; hover sunken-panel fill with text to ink.
components.do: Keep the active state a verdigris fill with white label — the loudest element in the header.
components.dont: Don't add a second active treatment or an underline.

components.pattern: Signature. 20px/700 Georgia numeral, tabular figures, verdigris, on a plate pinned 10px/8px inside the bottom-left of a trending card's cover. Plate is paper at 82% opacity.
components.do: Keep the scrim translucent so the numeral stays legible over any image without introducing a solid block.
components.dont: Don't add a second serif element anywhere, and don't move the numeral out of the cover.

motion.intention: Almost none, on purpose. The system is static by position: the only motion is a 0.12–0.15s colour shift that confirms a state change the user just caused. Anything more would import a liveliness this reading room is defined against.
motion.reducedMotion: Handled for the theme switch only — the one element with a non-colour transition.

motionMeta.rationale: There is no animation in the system, so a reduced-motion budget is not the limiting factor here; the limit is that three transition values exist at all. Any new motion must replace a colour transition, not add to the set.

icons.style: Vendored Phosphor SVG paths, stroke- or fill-rendered inline.
icons.rules: No emoji as UI glyphs. The only Unicode characters permitted in the interface are typographic marks that *are* the label — arrows, stars, dashes, ellipses. No icon font, no external icon CDN.

imagery.sources: Article covers generated into R2; original article images archived to R2; letter-avatar fallbacks for authors.
imagery.treatment: Covers crop to fill at a fixed aspect, clipped by the card's 10px radius. Missing imagery renders as an explicit missing-figure plate rather than a broken image or a silent placeholder.

knownGaps.issue:
Board pages emit a 13px/700 h1 as an eyebrow with the display size on a

beneath it. The visual move is deliberate and named, but the semantic heading is the small element, which reads oddly to a screen reader's heading list.
The three transition values are scattered as literals rather than declared as custom properties, so a duration change is a find-and-replace rather than a token edit.
The dark palette is a full parallel set of custom properties and is not represented in DESIGN.md's frontmatter tokens, which are light-only. The sidecar records it under colorMeta.primary only.
